no_scores.instruction: Retrieval scores and panel ranks are intentionally omitted in this ablation. Use the experimental records themselves; do not infer an unreported numerical weight from their ordering.

no_smiles.instruction: Evidence-molecule SMILES are intentionally omitted in this ablation. Use the available experimental records and retrieval metadata; do not treat the omitted structures themselves as missing experimental evidence.

no_query_smiles.instruction: The query SMILES is intentionally omitted in this ablation. Do not identify the query or reconstruct its structure from the remaining context. Absence of direct experimental measurements for the query remains a valid evidence gap.

no_query_prior.instruction: No query-property prior is supplied in this ablation. Treat earlier references to a supplied prior as inapplicable and base the prediction on the remaining visible query and evidence information and experimental records.

changes: Preserve the user-edited five-stage v46 system prompt and enforce matching query, neighborhood, ordered molecule, reflection, and final-judgment stages with non-nestable tags.
Require one free reasoning block per visible molecule with all of its C-number records and no categorical local contribution or evidence weight.
Keep reflection and final judgment free of required calibration checks or majority rules.
Allow up to 10000 characters independently in every free reasoning block while keeping retrieval inputs, inherited user payload, prompt modifiers, and final JSON validation unchanged.
